purpose: Reviewed given-name and suffix bridges between official House member names and names as printed in retained primary-result sources. Each alias is a reviewer decision, not an inference; it binds one bioguide identity to one source spelling in one district.

aliases.basis: Gabriel is the formal form of the given name Gabe; the surname, district, and 2024 Democratic primary cycle match, and the retained source lists a single Democratic candidate for RI-01.
